note: The headings list runs 16.1-16.8 with no sub-headings, so section 16.1's several distinct ideas (gross anatomy, nephron structure, cortical vs medullary nephrons and vasa recta) and 16.2's three processes share a from_heading across subtopics 2-4 and 5-7; they were kept separate because NEET questions target them individually. The chapter's opening section on types of nitrogenous waste (ammonotelism, ureotelism, uricotelism) has no heading in the input and survives in the passages only as the fragment P01 plus the SUMMARY passages P36/P37, although the exercises (P42, P43) ask about it repeatedly - subtopic 1 carries them, with from_heading 'unsure'. The SUMMARY splits cleanly across P36-P40 and each part went to the matching subtopic. The exercise passages P41-P45 span the chapter and were each attached to the subtopic their questions chiefly target (P41 GFR, P42/P43 nitrogenous wastes and osmoregulation, P44 kidney and nephron anatomy, P45 Henle's loop permeability and ADH).
